goal: Fatura merkezi ve form yanıtları UI'sında responsive, keyboard ve rol görünürlüğü kapısını geçirmek
rollback: Bu paketin responsive/role UI ve test değişikliklerini geri al; invoice, payment, document, delivery veya response verisini silme
acceptance: Invoice center and response layouts have no horizontal overflow or invisible critical actions at desktop/tablet/mobile widths
Export/import/send and PII actions respect role/policy visibility; no unauthorized active control is rendered
Keyboard focus, labels, disabled reasons and status semantics are present for dense action rows
Responsive changes do not alter payment/invoice/document/delivery data contracts
